intro:
在神秘之地，
两位宿敌的故事徐徐展开。

约翰，光之战士，
邪恶约翰，他的暗影双子。

邪恶约翰，被嫉妒裹挟，
企图征服两个世界。

凭其六只邪眼，
他腐化了大地。

约翰凭其游戏历史领域的知识，
他必须拯救这个岌岌可危的游戏世界。

postitem:
Legends has it, you can
press [SHIFT] to swap items.

By the way, have you seen that big
rock blocking the cave in the village?

People say it was blocked due to the
excessive amount of evil coming from inside...

advice.0:

Don't go wasting your bombs,
you only have a limited number.
